Commentary.Commentary: Harmanpreet Kaur has been handed the trophy. She gives the trophy to the youngsters of the team and the full team poses for a picture. Right then! That ends our proceedings of yet another enticing tournament. India Women are truly the deserving champions of Asia. However, Sri Lanka Women should be proud of themselves for reaching the final after 14 years. It was a tough defeat for them, but overall a good tournament. Remember the Women's T20 World Cup is just a few months away and this tournament will give India Women a confidence booster, while Sri Lanka Women will have some sort of thinking to do. That's it from here, folks. Goodbye and take care!

Harmanpreet Kaur the victories captain of India Women credits the bowlers for their bowling efforts, she says that their fielding unit was good as well, and she is really proud of every team member. Mentions that they have to read the wicket before a game and they did so and placed the fielders accordingly. Adds that they were not looking at the scoreboard, they had a target in mind that they had to achieve at the end of a few overs, which worked out well for them.

Chamari Athapaththu the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says that it is a tough defeat to take as a team. Adds that the batting display was not up to the mark. Mentions that they will learn from their mistakes and try to perform well in the upcoming T20 World Cup. Tells that they need to improve as a batting unit but says she is proud of her bowlers. Ends by saying that they do not have that many experienced players but a couple of young players have played well and she hopes that they will continue the same in the future.

Deepti Sharma (94 runs and 13 wickets) is the Player of the Series. She says that she is very happy and they played as a unit in this full tournament. Mentions that she backed her strengths and she focused on where she has to bowl. Adds that before the tournament she worked hard on her batting and it helped her in this series. Ends by saying that this win has given them a lot of confidence going into their next series.

Renuka Singh is the Player of the Match. She says that she is very happy with her performance. Adds that in the last couple of matches she did not bowl well but she trained hard with her coach to get back in rhythm. Mentions that she just tried to stick to her basics and tells that she had support from her captain, coaching staff, and other players.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the match, Chamari Athapaththu won the toss and decided to put runs on the board. However, things did not quite go according to her plan. They put on an abysmal batting show and managed to score only 65. India Women were magnificent with the ball. The spinners used the conditions perfectly and with the help of some poor running by the Lankan batters, they restricted Sri Lanka Women to a below-par total. Renuka Singh was the leader of the pack for India Women, she took 3 wickets, while Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Sneh Rana claimed two wickets each. In reply, Smriti Mandhana came out all guns blazing and took her side over the line along with Harmanpreet Kaur at the other end.

The batters of India Women came in to bat with aggressive and positive intent. Smriti Mandhana in particular started firing from the word go and gave Sri Lanka no chance whatsoever. Although her opening partner, Shafali Verma tried to be aggressive too, she perished while doing so. Jemimah Rodrigues too followed her back soon. But skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Smriti Mandhana ensured there were no more hiccups and guided India home. We cannot really blame the bowlers of Sri Lanka here as they had too little to fight with. Nevertheless, they still managed to get two wickets and it was Inoka Ranaweera and Kavisha Dilhari who grabbed a wicket apiece.

INDIA WOMEN ARE CHAMPIONS OF ASIA FOR THE SEVENTH TIME! It's been an absolute dominant show from the Women in Blue, not just in the final but in the full competition, barring that one game against, arch-rivals, Pakistan. This chase has been a walk in the park for the Indians. Well, chasing a target of 66 was always going to be a piece of cake for this formidable batting lineup. But we have witnessed a lopsided affair in this final, and it is India Women who go on to lift the gorgeous trophy. Agony for Sri Lanka Women though, they have done a commendable job to reach the final after 14 years but will be disappointed with their performance in this final game.

SIX! Smriti Mandhana finishes things off in style! FIFTY for Mandhana as well! Oshadi Ranasinghe tosses this up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. The India Women players run into the field and they are absolutely delighted. INDIA WOMEN WIN BY 8 WICKETS AND THEY ARE THE WOMEN'S ASIA CUP 2022 CHAMPIONS!

FOUR! SCORES LEVEL! Smriti Mandhana with another fine shot! This is flighted, full and on middle, Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and smashes it wide of mid on for a boundary. India Women just one run away from becoming the champions.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it towards square leg for a run.
WIDE! Looped up, short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur misses her cut. Wided.
Quicker, short and on off, turning in sharply, Smriti Mandhana gets cramped and knocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Over the top! This is tossed up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. 7 runs needed to win now.
A low full toss, on middle and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it wide of mid on where the fielder dives to her right to stop it. Only a single.
Looped up, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur lenas on and pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it with the inner half to the leg side.
Floated, short and on off, turning away, Harmanpreet Kaur watches it through and guides it towards the vacant third man region for a brace.
Short again and around off this time, Smriti Mandhana pushes it from her back foot towards cover.
Shortish and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur forces it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards cover.
Short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana goes on her back foot and tucks it wide of mid on for a quick single.

FOUR! Classic shot! This is pierced through the gap perfectly. Kavisha Dilhari bowls this short again and outside off, Smriti Mandhana moves back and cuts it through cover point for another boundary. 50 comes up for India Women and they need 16 more runs to win now.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana stays there and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Floated, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur leans on and blocks it out. India Women are on 42 for 2 after the end of Powerplay.
Flatter, short and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to cut it away but misses.
Short and on off, Smriti Mandhana moves back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lovely delivery! This is flighted, full and around off, turning in sharply, Smriti Mandhana looks to play at it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW but turned down.
Tossed up, full and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Pushed through quicker, on middle, turning in a bit, Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Full again, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur works it away towards mid-wicket for a single. India Women need 26 runs more.
FOUR! The skipper is off the mark in fine fashion. A fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur shimmies down the pitch and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward and blocks it out.
The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Kavisha Dilhari sends back the in-form, Jemimah Rodrigues. India Women have lost their second wicket. A shortish ball, spinning in, around the off pole, this one stays low as well. Jemimah Rodrigues advances down the track and tries to heave this one across the line. But she gets undone by the lack of bounce and the ball goes onto hit the base of the stumps.
Goes 'round the wicker for the left-hander, short in length, around middle. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Kavisha Dilhari begins with a short ball, spinning in, around the off pole. Jemimah Rodrigues works it away towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Kavisha Dilhari replaces Oshadi Ranasinghe.
Around middle and leg, short ball. Jemimah Rodrigues nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Full, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues leans in and blocks it out.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! STUMPED! Sri Lanka Women have their first breakthrough and it's Shafali Verma who departs. She tried to be aggressive here but she holes out. A fullish ball, outside off, hint of away turn there. Shafali Verma dances down the pitch and looks to downtown, but misses. Anushka Sanjeewani grabs the ball and whips the bails off.
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Inoka Ranaweera

Commentary.Commentary: Drifting in, around the leg pole. Shafali Verma misses her sweep. A stifled appeal there for LBW, but turned down.
Around middle, short ball, Smriti Mandhana works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Smriti Mandhana greets Inoka Ranaweera with a six! A fuller ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana dances down the pitch and smokes it over long on for a maximum.
Inoka Ranaweera comes into the attack now.
Short ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it off the back foot towards cover for a single. India Women are 41 runs away now.
Outside off, fuller ball this time. Shafali Verma advances down the pitch and ends up dragging this with the inner half of her bat wide of long on. Only a single.
Darting it on the pads, a short ball. Smriti Mandhana nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A six followed by a four. India Women are in a hurry. A short ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana uses the depth of her crease and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Pitches this one up, full, around middle. Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the track and goes inside-out over cover all the way for a biggie. Glorious!
Very full now, around middle. Shafali Verma drills it towards long on. A single.
Width on offer now, shorter ball. Smriti Mandhana cuts it through point for a brace. 7 runs off the over. India Women need 55 runs more.
FOUR! In the gap this time! Outside off, short again. Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the pitch and punches it through cover for a boundary.
Sticks to bowling short-length deliveries, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length again, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it off the back foot towards the fielder at cover.
Short in length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and knocks it towards the fielder at cover.
Sugandika Kumari begins with a fuller ball, around middle. Shafali Verma strokes it down towards long on. A single is taken.
Sugandika Kumari to bowl from the other end.
In the air and safe! Full, slower through the air, around middle and off. Shafali Verma looks to flick this one but the ball goes off the leading edge and over mid off. Single!
Back of a length now, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it off the back foot towards mid off for a single.
This one comes in, full in length, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana steps down and looks to go over cover but the ball goes off the inside edge and onto her pads.
Outside off, fuller balll. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards cover.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Shafali Verma knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Shafali Verma is off the mark with that.
Full, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma tucks it towards short fine leg.
Wide! Wide of off, short ball. Shafali Verma misses her cut. Wide called. India Women are underway.
